cards.title: Team talk, in five steps
cards.text: The note travels in AskAgent's message: no tool change, no engine change, no sentiment model.

cards.title: Step 1: the prompt
cards.text: The note's shape, the mood rule and the off marker. Built.

cards.title: Step 2: the API
cards.text: read_mood on the message endpoint; a marker line when it's off.

cards.title: Step 3: the chat
cards.text: The Lees my stemming toggle, the card as a thread, the Werk panel's mood chip.

cards.title: Step 4: the checks
cards.text: Both checks score briefed and record the mood; saved samples re-reported.

cards.title: Verification
cards.text: Terse and long questions by hand, the toggle mid-chat, a run of each check on Louis's go.
